student_learning_goal: I can decode CVC words and read decodable text.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can decode CVC words and read decodable text.
header.character_watermark: Sounder Sam and Blendy together in the top-right with the 4-step decoder process icons. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: For 2 pictures, segment the word into 3 sounds and write a letter for each sound.
parts.visual_layout: Two picture icons each above a 3-cell sound box for writing letters.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 capstone hear-and-map layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. 2 pictures (cat, dog) each above a 3-cell sound box. Boxes are large enough for letters.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P1_HEAR at Part 1: keywords name the picture and sound box hear-and-map task.

parts.student_instructions: Read each sound-box word. Write the word on the line.
parts.visual_layout: Two sound-box words with letters in cells and handwriting lines below for the child to write the blended word.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 capstone blend layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. 2 sound-box words (PIN, MAP) with letters filled. Below each: a handwriting line ~3in for the child to write the word.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P2_BLEND at Part 2: keywords name the letters in boxes and write-the-word task.

parts.student_instructions: Read each sentence. Circle the CVC words you decoded.
parts.visual_layout: Two sentence rows printed in large font with circle space around each CVC word.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 capstone read layout for phonics worksheet, B&W line art. 2 sentences in large font: 'The pig sat in a hat.', 'A bus on the mat.' Each CVC word has space around it for the child to circle.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P3_READ at Part 3: keywords name the sentence rows and circle-the-CVC-word reading task.

parts.answer_key: Circled: pig, sat, hat; bus, mat.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write your own decodable sentence using one CVC word.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone. Summative artifact — score on the 5-row rubric in the assessment_suite.
